messages:
mara: FYI NimbusHealth (acct:nimbus-123) flagged INV-2026-047  they believe the Dedicated burst line is double-charged. They attached the PDF and want confirmation. :neutral_face:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 generated 2026-03-29T08:12Z total_due $18,450 https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-047
samir: Can we get the raw billed lines? need to check committed vs burst math before replying.
natalie: Contract: 50k committed tokens/month. Pre-bill shows ~180k total tokens (so 130k burst). Customer PDF shows burst ~260k. That mismatch looks like duplicated burst events. :thinking_face:
eli: pulling raw events now. early sample (sanitized):
```
2026-03-29T07:59:02Z,nimbus-123,burst,130000,event_id=evt-9a1b
2026-03-29T07:59:05Z,nimbus-123,burst,130000,event_id=evt-9a1b  # retry duplicate
```
eli: root cause appears to be non-idempotent writes in the billing-processor when downstream ACKs timed out. Ill run dedupe+reprocess and upload corrected CSV to s3 by EOD.
mara: Pause collection on INV-2026-047 and provisionally approve a credit of $7,200 to cover the erroneous overage (credit > $5k needs lead sign-off). @samir please notify the customer were investigating and will issue a proforma credit.
samir: Messaging Nimbus now: "Were pausing collection while we reconcile an issue in our billing export. Expect a provisional credit memo and corrected invoice within 48h."
natalie: Customer procurement wants a credit memo they can share internally. Ill draft one after finance signs off and we have the corrected export.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-047 status -> credit_pending; ticket TICKET-5324 created.
mara: Thanks. Once eli confirms corrected export and counts reconcile, finance will post final credit and reissue the invoice. Aim to close within 48h. :thumbsup:
